book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 4 Approaching Classics 走进经典
source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 4 词表(p70-77 + Listening glossary p87-89 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、文学/经典主题(海明威《老人与海》·莎士比亚·苏轼·湖畔派诗人·读经典),含目标词、不超纲;多义给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The Old Man and the Sea is a true classic of world literature.
words.example_cn: 《老人与海》是一部真正的世界文学经典。

words.example_en: Hemingway won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1954.
words.example_cn: 海明威于1954年获得诺贝尔文学奖。

words.example_en: This famous novel tells the story of an old fisherman.
words.example_cn: 这部著名小说讲述了一位老渔夫的故事。

words.example_en: The author of the novel was an American writer.
words.example_cn: 这部小说的作者是一位美国作家。

words.example_en: As a skilful narrator, Hemingway made the simple story unforgettable.
words.example_cn: 作为高明的叙述者,海明威让这个简单的故事令人难忘。

words.example_en: The old man fought on despite his physical handicap.
words.example_cn: 尽管身体有缺陷,老人仍继续搏斗。

words.meaning_cn: 难以忍受的;无法承受的
words.example_en: The pain in the old man's hands was almost unbearable.
words.example_cn: 老人手上的疼痛几乎令人无法忍受。

words.example_en: He believed he was more intelligent than the shark.
words.example_cn: 他相信自己比鲨鱼更聪明。

words.example_en: He knew what might happen when he reached the inner current.
words.example_cn: 他知道到达内侧水流时可能会发生什么。

words.example_en: The great fish began to bleed after the shark attacked it.
words.example_cn: 鲨鱼袭击之后,那条大鱼开始流血。

words.example_en: A man can be destroyed but not defeated, the old man said.
words.example_cn: 老人说,一个人可以被毁灭,但不能被打败。

words.example_en: A man can be destroyed, yet he should never give up.
words.example_cn: 一个人可以被毁灭,但绝不该放弃。

words.example_en: The hero slowly learns to conquer his own fear and doubt.
words.example_cn: 主人公慢慢学会克服自己的恐惧与怀疑。

words.example_en: Language should never be a barrier to enjoying world classics.
words.example_cn: 语言绝不应成为欣赏世界经典的障碍。

words.example_en: The pursuit of beauty and truth lies at the heart of poetry.
words.example_cn: 对美与真理的追求是诗歌的核心。

words.example_en: Each verse of the poem paints a picture of spring.
words.example_cn: 这首诗的每一节都描绘出一幅春天的画面。

words.example_en: Wordsworth was a famous English Romantic poet.
words.example_cn: 华兹华斯是一位著名的英国浪漫主义诗人。

words.example_en: We read poetry because we belong to the human race.
words.example_cn: 我们读诗,是因为我们属于人类。

words.example_en: The Lake Poets were part of the Romantic movement.
words.example_cn: 湖畔派诗人是浪漫主义运动的一部分。

words.example_en: After the rain, blue sky began to prevail over the hills.
words.example_cn: 雨过之后,蓝天开始笼罩群山。

words.example_en: In the poem, the calm lake seems to glitter in the sun.
words.example_cn: 在诗中,平静的湖面似乎在阳光下闪耀。

words.example_en: In Wordsworth's poem, the cattle graze quietly in the field.
words.example_cn: 在华兹华斯的诗里,牛群在田野中静静吃草。

words.example_en: The cattle in the poem feed peacefully like one animal.
words.example_cn: 诗中的牛群像一头牲畜般安详地进食。

words.example_en: Snow still lingers on the top of the bare hill.
words.example_cn: 光秃秃的山顶上仍残留着积雪。

words.example_en: There is joy in the mountains when spring returns.
words.example_cn: 春天回来时,群山之中充满欢乐。

words.example_en: Amid the noise of the city, poetry reminds us why we live.
words.example_cn: 在城市的喧嚣中,诗歌提醒我们为何而活。

words.example_en: Whitman asks what good there is amid the faithless crowds.
words.example_cn: 惠特曼追问,在不忠的人群中又有什么意义。

words.example_en: Each of us may contribute a verse to the play of life.
words.example_cn: 我们每个人都能为生命这出戏添上一句诗。

words.example_en: The old man drew inspiration from the great baseball player.
words.example_cn: 老人从那位伟大的棒球选手身上汲取灵感。

words.example_en: The fisherman faced the sharks with quiet determination.
words.example_cn: 渔夫以沉静的决心面对群鲨。

words.example_en: The old man fought for his pride and dignity to the end.
words.example_cn: 老人为自己的骄傲与尊严战斗到底。

words.example_en: Hemingway praised the old man's decency and courage.
words.example_cn: 海明威赞美老人的正派与勇气。

words.example_en: This time Hemingway wrote about pity and human love.
words.example_cn: 这一次,海明威写的是怜悯与人间的爱。

words.example_en: We feel deep sympathy for the lonely old fisherman.
words.example_cn: 我们对孤独的老渔夫深感同情。

words.example_en: The beauty of Hemingway's style lies in its simplicity.
words.example_cn: 海明威文风之美在于它的质朴。

words.example_en: A classic is often a work of high authority in its field.
words.example_cn: 经典往往是某一领域里极具权威的作品。

words.example_en: Reading classics deepens our appreciation of beauty.
words.example_cn: 阅读经典加深了我们对美的鉴赏。

words.example_en: Great literature deals with enduring, timeless truths.
words.example_cn: 伟大的文学探讨的是永恒不朽的真理。

words.example_en: 'All the world's a stage' is Shakespeare's famous monologue.
words.example_cn: “全世界是一个舞台”是莎士比亚著名的独白。

words.example_en: Shakespeare is seen as the greatest playwright of all time.
words.example_cn: 莎士比亚被视为有史以来最伟大的剧作家。

words.example_en: Shakespeare wrote more than one hundred and fifty sonnets.
words.example_cn: 莎士比亚写了一百五十多首十四行诗。

words.example_en: When the curtain rose, the actors began the play.
words.example_cn: 幕布升起时,演员们开始了演出。

words.example_en: The whole auditorium fell silent as the poem began.
words.example_cn: 诗朗诵开始时,整个礼堂安静了下来。

words.example_en: The young actor made his first appearance on the stage.
words.example_cn: 这位年轻演员首次登台演出。

words.example_en: The students wished their teacher would give a lecture on poems.
words.example_cn: 学生们希望老师能给他们开一堂关于诗歌的讲座。

words.example_en: The poet did not intend his words to be forgotten.
words.example_cn: 诗人并不想让自己的诗句被遗忘。

words.example_en: The class listened intently as the teacher read the verse.
words.example_cn: 老师朗读诗句时,全班专注地听着。

words.example_en: She will deliver a speech about Chinese classics on Reading Day.
words.example_cn: 她将在读书日发表一篇关于中国经典的演讲。
